Know a place?
Put its knowledge
on the map.

A useful contribution can be one reliable source, a working connection, or a better question.

  1. 01

    Pick an area. Follow a question.

    Choose a county, watershed or place. Look into wells, river history, water quality, rights or access.

  2. 02

    Take a prompt to your own AI.

    We prepare a focused research brief. Use your own tools to find original sources, record dates and identify gaps.

  3. 03

    Share what you can verify.

    Propose your findings on GitHub. Community review adds traceable knowledge, one contribution at a time.

HOW TO READ WATER ATLAS

A map of what we know.

County colors show the depth of published information in Water Atlas. They do not describe water abundance, water quality, drilling prospects or permission to use water.

Not indexed
No published collection for this area yet. Records and water may exist elsewhere.
Sources listed
Original publications and access instructions are available.
Organized records
A dated, structured collection can be explored. Coverage can still be partial.
Connected
Named reusable retrieval methods have been tested, with their test dates shown.
Reviewed
The stated sources and methods have independent community review. This does not establish completeness.

The first collection includes 774 source records within 50 miles of Terlingua and 353 regional source entries, dated October 23, 2026. It includes parts of Brewster and Presidio counties. Texas records leave the Mexican portion of the study circle uncovered.

The current collection is a snapshot. General live connectors and background updates are planned. Original observations, publication dates, retrieval dates and review dates describe different events.

World geography is generalized Natural Earth data; U.S. county boundaries are Census cartographic data. Use source records for detailed geographic or legal questions. Geographic source details ↗

This website is static. The map, search and prompt builder run in your browser. It has no hosted AI, application database, tracking or Water Atlas account requirement.
